meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 对时间序列数据进行机器学习分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理带有时间索引的数据并需要专门的时序算法
copy.tagline_en: Perform machine learning analysis on time series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with time-indexed data and need specialized time series algorithms

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能利用 aeon 工具处理时间序列数据,完成分类、预测、异常检测等任务,并生成相应 Python 代码。它会遵循 aeon 1.x 的 API 规范,需要时查阅内置参考文档。
howto.when: 当任务涉及时间序列数据时触发,例如要求对时序数据进行分类、异常检测或未来值预测。也适用于聚类相似时间序列等场景。

say.text: 用 aeon 对这份时间序列做分类
say.note: Claude 会加载数据并调用 aeon 分类器。

say.text: 帮我用 aeon 检测这个序列的异常点
say.note: 会使用 STOMP 等检测器输出异常分数。

say.text: 用 aeon 预测未来 5 个时间点的值
say.note: 会选用合适的预测器并给出预测结果。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude uses aeon to handle time-series tasks—classification, forecasting, anomaly detection—and writes Python code using aeon 1.x APIs, consulting built-in refs when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task involves time-series data, e.g., classifying temporal sequences, detecting anomalies, or forecasting future values, as well as clustering similar series.

say_en.text: Classify this time series using aeon.
say_en.note: Claude loads data and runs an aeon classifier.

say_en.text: Detect anomalies in this series with aeon.
say_en.note: Uses detectors like STOMP to score anomalies.

say_en.text: Forecast the next 5 points with aeon.
say_en.note: Picks a forecaster and returns predictions.
